chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: "Lady Be Good" routine and returning to Hamp on alto
summary: McRae burlesqued with Cobb and, years later, taught Lucky Thompson's section the routine when Hamp called him back.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
